capabilities: Chat with cloud and local LLMs about notes, folders, or the entire vault
Save, edit, search, and share code snippets and materials via Pieces Drive
Access Long-Term Memory across workflows and apps
Save and share materials with inline quick actions on block elements
Launch Copilot from the editor context menu on selected code
disambiguation: Not just a snippet manager; it also adds vault-wide AI chat and cross-app long-term memory via the Pieces app.
extras: Closed-source plugin; the README includes a community disclosure noting no client-side telemetry and temporary use of cloud LLM API endpoints. Full documentation lives elsewhere.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to query LLMs with vault context or store, search, and reuse code snippets across apps.
summary: AI assistant that brings Pieces Copilot, Long-Term Memory, and Pieces Drive into Obsidian for chatting with notes and managing reusable code snippets.
